name: Sagisawa Misaki
source: Misaki is a young girl who stays at home, looking out at the world, and Yoriko is her cat. Yoriko jumps out of Misaki's window to see the world in her place, and was transformed into a maid with cat ears. Yoriko has a fear of people after an incident with some children, and it takes her a long time to venture outside.
